response_property_constraints.description: The type of the album must be one of 'album', 'single', or 'compilation'.
The object type must be the literal string 'album'.
The markets in which the album is available must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (two uppercase letters).
The precision with which the release_date value is known must be one of 'year', 'month', or 'day'.
The Spotify URI for the album must begin with 'spotify:album:'.
The href must be a link to the Web API endpoint providing full details of the album (an absolute URL).
The object type of each artist must be the literal string 'artist'.
The Spotify URI for each artist must begin with 'spotify:artist:'.
The source URL of each image must be an absolute URL.
The previous field must be a URL to the previous page of items, or null if none.
The next field must be a URL to the next page of items, or null if none.

request_response_constraints.description: The 'limit' field in the response must equal the value of the 'limit' request query parameter (the maximum number of items to return).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The maximum number of items to return

request_response_constraints.description: The number of items returned must not exceed the 'limit' request query parameter (the maximum number of items to return).
request_response_constraints.corresponding_attribute_description: The maximum number of items to return
